# Vendored design system

**Not covered by the AGPL. See [TRADEMARKS.md](../../../../../TRADEMARKS.md).**

These CSS files are the PactJoy design system (colors, typography, spacing, motion, base styles and
component styles). They are part of the PactJoy visual identity: the source code of this repository
is AGPL-3.0, these files are not. Do not reuse them to suggest a project is official or endorsed.

## Provenance

- Source: Claude Design project `239122e1-7217-4b6b-ac98-3383f1876fc6`
- Folder: `_ds/pactjoy-design-system-32903670-ae91-4b25-8e1e-6054197166b5/`
- Vendored: 2026-10-03, verbatim except HTML-entity decoding of the `read_file` output.
- Every file starts with a provenance header; the sha256 of each body is in `MANIFEST.json` and a
  test recomputes it. Do not edit these files: re-vendor them from the source instead.
- `tokens/fonts.css` is not vendored. Fonts come from `@fontsource/nunito-sans` (SIL OFL 1.1).
